task: Predict TP53 mutation status in glioblastoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, useful distinctions include degree of nuclear pleomorphism, giant-cell change, cellular atypia, mitotic activity, necrosis, and infiltrative astrocytic morphology.

classes.0: TP53 wildtype glioblastoma with conventional high-grade astrocytic features but less emphasis on marked pleomorphism or giant-cell morphology.
classes.1: TP53 mutant glioblastoma showing pronounced nuclear atypia, pleomorphism, and sometimes giant-cell or highly anaplastic morphology.
